title: Merge queue
description: A merged PR receives an atomic item-owned merge receipt and landing stamps before the holder is notified. Worker closeout still owns results and verification. A queue entry marked UNMERGEABLE stops the landing once GitHub decides its mergeability, even before GitHub removes it; while GitHub still reports mergeable as unknown, the landing stays pending and no notice goes out. An open PR whose merge state GitHub reports as unknown is also still pending: GitHub reports unknown while it recomputes, including mid-merge after it clears the queue entry and merge-when-ready. A conflicting entry's notice names rebase onto the base, verification, and governed merge re-entry. A mergeable entry needs no holder action: the landing observer re-enqueues the unchanged head by itself, and a hold would switch that recovery off.
